description: Per-window capability of a file manager opened beside a remote-view window (ADR 0124). It is one session's files and nothing else: the two listings, the transfers between them, the three changes a file manager makes (make a folder, rename, delete) and the list of local drives to start from. Every file command still checks that the window's label names the session it acts on, and every remote one is re-authorized by the host when it lands. `core:event:default` is what lets the page hear a file dragged in from the desktop, which arrives as a Tauri event carrying the dropped paths; its own close and destroy are scoped to its own label. No screen, input, keyboard, shell, tunnel, grant or settings command, no filesystem plugin, and no wildcard entries.
